name: status-notify
description: notify-send when a long turn finishes or a rate-limit window runs hot (with reset time); toast when context fills up.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a desktop notification when a turn takes at least this long.

limitWarnPercent.title: Limit warning (%)
limitWarnPercent.description: Notify when the 5h or 7d window passes this.

limitCriticalPercent.title: Limit critical (%)
limitCriticalPercent.description: Second, urgent notification at this level.

contextNudgePercent.title: Context nudge (%)
contextNudgePercent.description: Toast suggesting /compact when context passes this.
